mapper.select: select cai.id, cai.company_id as orgId, ifnull( cei.abbreviation, '公司' ) as orgName, cai.account_item_id as accountItemId, ai.name as accountItemName, ai.type, cai.inservice from clinic_account_item cai left join account_item ai on cai.account_item_id = ai.id left join clinic_ext_info cei on cai.company_id = cei.company_id where cai.id = #{id}
